name: Google Chrome
description: Main browser used for onboarding links, internal resources, and standard bookmarks.
helpText: Required for the standard onboarding experience. The installer checks if Chrome already exists before installing.

name: Git and Git Bash
description: Version control command-line tools and Git Bash shell.
helpText: Required for software engineering workflows such as cloning repositories, branching, committing, pulling, and pushing code.

name: Visual Studio 2026
description: Primary IDE for the current engineering setup using the team Visual Studio 2026 configuration.
helpText: Required/default IDE setup. Uses Configs\vs2026.vsconfig. Run the app as Administrator before installing.

name: Visual Studio 2022
description: Optional legacy-compatible Visual Studio installation for projects that still require VS2022.
helpText: Optional. Uses Configs\VS2022.vsconfig. Only install this if a project, build process, or extension still requires Visual Studio 2022.

name: .NET SDK 10
description: Required .NET SDK used for development and build workflows.
helpText: Uses Configs\Installers\dotnet-sdk-10.0.301-win-x64.exe. The script checks for an existing .NET 10 SDK before installing.

name: Windows SDK
description: Windows development kit used by some desktop, native, and build workloads.
helpText: Uses Configs\Installers\winsdksetup.exe. Required by some desktop/native development scenarios.

name: Notepad++
description: Lightweight editor for quick text, config, XML, JSON, log, and script file edits.
helpText: Optional editor. After installing, use Windows Default Apps if you want to associate .txt, .log, .json, or .xml files with Notepad++.

name: Visual Studio Code
description: Lightweight editor for scripting, quick repository browsing, and general development tasks.
helpText: Optional. Useful for quick edits, scripting, browsing repositories, and lightweight development outside full Visual Studio.

name: GitExtensions
description: Graphical user interface for Git repositories used for repository management.
helpText: Graphical Git client used for cloning and managing the SystemSource repository.

name: KDiff3
description: Diff and merge tool for comparing files and resolving merge conflicts.
helpText: Optional diff/merge tool. Useful for file comparison and resolving source-control conflicts.

name: Araxis Merge
description: Alternative commercial diff and merge tool available through the corporate software page.
helpText: Optional. Opens the corporate software page for Araxis Merge. This may require a request or license approval.

name: ReSharper
description: JetBrains productivity extension for Visual Studio.
helpText: Optional. Opens the ReSharper download page. Replace this later with a corporate-managed installer if your team provides one.

name: Default Apps - Browser
description: Open Windows Default Apps settings so the user can set Chrome as the default browser.
helpText: Optional guided step. Use this after installing Chrome if you want Chrome to handle links by default.

name: Default Apps - Text Editor
description: Open Windows Default Apps settings so the user can set Notepad++ or another editor for text files.
helpText: Optional guided step. Use this after installing Notepad++ if you want it to open .txt, .log, .json, .xml, or similar files.

name: Prisma Browser Guide
description: Guided link for Prisma Browser setup while waiting for VPN or E5 access.
helpText: Optional guided step. Use Prisma Browser temporarily if GlobalProtect/VPN access is blocked.
